title: Zero-Knowledge Fitness Platform
summary: A privacy-first fitness platform that keeps workout state and private keys on the client while supporting proof-carrying encrypted sync.
notes: A buildless PWA with IndexedDB persistence, browser cryptography, post-quantum authentication, encrypted sync, and a Node.js API backed by PostgreSQL.
A scoped Groth16 proof verifies a private workout summary and its binding to the encrypted record. It does not prove the encryption internals or decrypt the payload.
proof: Local-first workflows, AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, Circom, Groth16, Poseidon, Docker, CI checks, and an automated security report.
